---
title: "rsync"
---

Interpret the `--itemize-changes` (`-i`) flags shown before each path. (rsync 3.2.7)

- The complete format is `YXcstpoguax`.
  - `Y`: update type.
    - `c`: a local change or creation occurred.
    - `.`: the item was not updated.
    - `*`: the remaining output contains an rsync message.
  - `X`: item type.
    - `f`: file.
    - `d`: directory.
    - `L`: symlink.
    - `D`: device.
  - `cstpoguax`: changed attributes, in order.
    - `c`: checksum or file value.
    - `s`: size.
    - `t`: modification time.
    - `p`: permissions.
    - `o`: owner.
    - `g`: group.
    - `u`, `n`, or `b`: access time, create time, or both.
    - `a`: ACL.
    - `x`: extended attributes.
    - `+`: the attribute is new or not applicable.
- Examples:
  - `cd+++++++++ ./`: rsync created the directory `./`.
  - `cd+++++++++ build_workflows/`: rsync created the directory `build_workflows/`.


a nice rsync command

```bash
INPUT_SRC_REPO=/workspace
#DEST_HOST=sscc-linstat-vm
#DEST_REPO=/home/s/sbryant8/LS/09_REPOS/USFloods_inference
DEST_HOST=ap2002-chtc-vpn
DEST_REPO=/home/sbryant8/LS/09_REPOS/USFloods_inference

RSYNC_FILE_LIST="${PWD}/smk/rsync_inputs_files.txt"


RSYNC_FLAGS=(
  # Default quick-check updates files when size or mtime differs.
  --archive          # Recurse and preserve common file metadata.
  --recursive        # Recurse into directory entries from --files-from.
  --verbose          # Print transferred paths.
  --relative         # Preserve paths relative to the repository root.
  --delete           # Remove stale destination-only files inside mirrored directories.
  --itemize-changes  # Show concise per-file change flags.
  --human-readable   # Show readable file sizes.
  --info=progress2   # Show aggregate progress.
  --outbuf=L         # Flush progress and stats promptly.
  --stats            # Summarize transfer counts and sizes.
)
RSYNC_INPUT_ARGS=(
  --files-from="${RSYNC_FILE_LIST}"
  "${INPUT_SRC_REPO}/"
  "${DEST_HOST}:${DEST_REPO}/"
)


ssh "${DEST_HOST}" "mkdir -p '${DEST_REPO}/_inputs/eval'"
rsync "${RSYNC_FLAGS[@]}" --dry-run "${RSYNC_INPUT_ARGS[@]}"


rsync "${RSYNC_FLAGS[@]}" "${RSYNC_INPUT_ARGS[@]}"
```
